  flexsurv, survival
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({

}))

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({

}))

source(here("scripts/R/functions/model_fun.R"))
source(here("scripts/R/functions/calculate_outcomes.R"))

```{r run-all-models, include=FALSE}
all_results <- run_all_basecase_analyses(verbose = TRUE)

model_labels <- c(
  Model_A = "Model A (Joint)",
  Model_B = "Model B (Focused)",
  Model_C = "Model C (Separate)"
)
```

```{r create-frontier-panels, include=FALSE}
strategy_colors <- c(
  "control" = "gray50",
  "crp" = "#E69F00",
  "tlr" = "#009E73",
  "tmb_braf" = "#0072B2"
)

strategy_labels <- c(
  "control" = "Standard care",
  "crp" = "CRP-guided",
  "tlr" = "TLR-guided",
  "tmb_braf" = "TMB/BRAF-guided"
)

panels <- list()

for (model_name in names(all_results)) {
  result <- all_results[[model_name]]
  icer_df <- as.data.frame(result$icer_obj)

  # Build plot data
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    Strategy = icer_df$Strategy,
    Cost = icer_df$Cost,
    Effect = icer_df$Effect,
    Status = icer_df$Status,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  plot_df$Label <- strategy_labels[plot_df$Strategy]
  plot_df$Color <- strategy_colors[plot_df$Strategy]

  # Identify frontier strategies (non-dominated)
  frontier <- plot_df %>% filter(Status %in% c("ND", "ref"))
  frontier <- frontier[order(frontier$Effect), ]

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Effect, y = Cost)) +
    # Frontier line (connecting non-dominated strategies)
    {if (nrow(frontier) > 1)
      geom_line(data = frontier, aes(x = Effect, y = Cost),
                linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.5)
    } +
    # Points for all strategies
    geom_point(aes(color = Label, shape = ifelse(Status %in% c("D", "ED"), "Dominated", "Frontier")),
               size = 4) +
    # Labels
    geom_text(aes(label = Label), hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = setNames(strategy_colors, strategy_labels), name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Dominated" = 4, "Frontier" = 16), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "\u20AC", big.mark = ",")) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    labs(
      x = "QALYs",
      y = "Cost (EUR)",
      title = model_labels[model_name]
    ) +
    # WTP threshold line through reference strategy
    {
      ref_row <- plot_df[plot_df$Status %in% c("ND", "ref") & plot_df$Cost == min(plot_df$Cost[plot_df$Status %in% c("ND", "ref")]), ]
      if (nrow(ref_row) > 0) {
        geom_abline(intercept = ref_row$Cost[1] - WTP * ref_row$Effect[1],
                    slope = WTP, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.4)
      }
    } +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    # Expand axes for labels
    expand_limits(
      x = max(plot_df$Effect) * 1.15,
      y = max(plot_df$Cost) * 1.1
    )

  panels[[model_name]] <- p
}
```

```{r combined-figure, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
if (length(panels) > 0) {
  combined_plot <- plot_grid(
    plotlist = panels,
    ncol = 3,
    labels = c("A", "B", "C"),
    label_size = 14
  )

  print(combined_plot)
}
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
if (length(panels) > 0) {
  figs_dir <- here("figs")
  if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
    dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  ggsave(
    filename = here("figs", "figure_s5.png"),
    plot = combined_plot,
    width = 14,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )

  cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure_s5.png"), "\n")
}
```

Figure S5 has been saved to `figs/figure_s5.png`.
